import math,json
sq=math.sqrt
def mm(A,B):return[[sum(A[i][k]*B[k][j]for k in range(len(B)))for j in range(len(B[0]))]for i in range(len(A))]
def dg(A):return[[A[j][i].conjugate()for j in range(len(A))]for i in range(len(A[0]))]
def kr(*xs):
 O=[[1]]
 for A in xs:O=[[O[i//len(A)][j//len(A[0])]*A[i%len(A)][j%len(A[0])]for j in range(len(O[0])*len(A[0]))]for i in range(len(O)*len(A))]
 return O
def ov(T,S):
 M=[];r=0
 for t in T:
  row=[]
  for s in S:
   X=mm(dg(t),s);q=sum(X[i][i]for i in range(2))/2;r=max(r,max(abs(X[i][j]-(q if i==j else 0))for i in range(2)for j in range(2)));row.append(q)
  M.append(row)
 return M,r
def er(A,B):return max(abs(A[i][j]-B[i][j])for i in range(len(A))for j in range(len(A[0])))
I=[[1,0],[0,1]];EA=[[1/sq(2)],[0],[0],[1/sq(2)]];EB=[[0],[1/sq(2)],[-1/sq(2)],[0]];EC=[[1/sq(2),0],[0,-1/sq(2)],[0,-1/sq(2)],[-1/sq(2),0]];JB=[[1,0],[0,-1]]
Wg=[[-sq(3)+1j,0],[0,-2j],[1+1j*sq(3),0],[0,2]];Wh=[[z.conjugate()for z in r]for r in Wg];ag=(-sq(3)-1j)/2;ah=ag.conjugate();VG=[[ag*z/(2*sq(2))for z in r]for r in Wg];VH=[[ah*z/(2*sq(2))for z in r]for r in Wh]
Eys=[EA,EB];Jys=[I,JB];Ez=[VG,VH];CyF=[VH,VG]
T1=[mm(mm(kr(EC,I,I),kr(Eys[k],I)),Jys[k])for k in range(2)];T2=[mm(mm(kr(I,EC,I),kr(Eys[k],I)),Jys[k])for k in range(2)];T3=[mm(kr(EC,Ez[k]),CyF[k])for k in range(2)];T4=[mm(mm(kr(I,EC,I),kr(I,Ez[k])),CyF[k])for k in range(2)];T5=[mm(mm(kr(I,I,Ez[k]),kr(I,Ez[k])),CyF[1-k])for k in range(2)]
Ts=[T1,T2,T3,T4,T5];grams=max(er(mm(dg(x),x),I)for T in Ts for x in T);edges={}
for a,b in [(1,0),(3,1),(4,3),(2,4),(2,0)]:edges[f'{a+1}<-{b+1}']=ov(Ts[a],Ts[b])
D=edges['3<-1'][0];C=mm(edges['3<-5'][0],mm(edges['5<-4'][0],mm(edges['4<-2'][0],edges['2<-1'][0])));fmt=lambda M:[[str(complex(round(z.real,12),round(z.imag,12)))for z in r]for r in M]
print(json.dumps({'gram_residual':grams,'scalar_residual':max(x[1]for x in edges.values()),'edges':{k:fmt(v[0])for k,v in edges.items()},'pentagon_residual':er(D,C)},indent=2))
